idea-plugin.name: Git Diff Review
idea-plugin.description:
Follow code navigation across Git Staging diffs, unchanged source and single usage results. Keep the Commit preview, staging controls and mixed source/diff Back/Forward history.

Configure automatic review sessions and staged-only scope under Version Control. Pause review or inspect the latest navigation reason from the status bar.

Review unstaged changes by default. Fully staged targets open as source, and history follows their current unstaged state without automatically returning to reviewed changes.

Navigate through native one-sided diffs for new files. New-file targets open in Diff by default; a project preference can open them as source while keeping review history.

Stage or unstage selected lines from a floating toolbar. Active source tabs locate matching files in the visible Commit tree while preserving manual multi-selection.

Compare with Staged from a source editor opens the Commit review preview for the file's unstaged changes, including selected-line staging, with native comparison fallback.

Targets IntelliJ platform build 262 with Git4Idea. Currently tested with GoLand 2026.2; compatibility with other JetBrains IDEs is not yet verified.
